entities.name: Peutz–Jeghers syndrome
observations: Autosomal-dominant STK11-associated hamartomatous gastrointestinal polyposis syndrome; perioral mucocutaneous freckles and paternal intestinal polyps are characteristic.
Adolescent patients have substantial risk of small-bowel intussusception, with reported median onset around 15–16 years and cumulative risk near 50% by age 20.

entities.name: Adolescent small-bowel intussusception
observations: In Peutz–Jeghers syndrome cohorts, intussusception occurred in 48% with median onset at 15.0 years; another cohort reported median first occurrence at 16 years and approximately 50% cumulative risk by age 20.
Events were predominantly in the small intestine; bleeding and obstruction may occur, whereas ischemia, infarction, and perforation are generally secondary consequences.
